text:
olivia: Hey team — I addressed the review comments on PR #1234: moved retry logic into retry.go, added TestBackoffJitter, trimmed the default timeout, and updated CHANGELOG. PTAL when you have a minute. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234

rahul: thanks olivia, quick skim looks good. one small nit: in retry.go the comment for MaxRetries still says 5 but default is now 3. can you update that comment? also curious why the jitter multiplier changed from 0.2 -> 0.15 — can you add a brief note in the changelog explaining the perf/regression tradeoff?

olivia: good catch — fixed the comment and added a line in the changelog explaining the jitter change and why it helps tail-latency. pushed a small commit: `git show --name-only HEAD` output included. PTAL again.

ci-bot: CI — build #8421 passed ✅ (unit tests + lint). Coverage unchanged.

emily: PTAL as well — will this affect canary timing? we have a canary window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. need to know if we should reserve extra capacity or expect a rollback.

olivia: not expected to need extra capacity. the change trims unnecessary sleep in hot path; it slightly reduces token-generation latency variance. we also added a safety fallback to model-variant B if latency spikes > 2s for 3 consecutive requests. so rollback unlikely; we can keep standard canary cadence. added the fallback config snippet to the PR:
```yaml
fallbacks:
  - condition: consecutive_latency_ms > 2000
    action: route_to: model-variant-b
```

rahul: LGTM after the comment fix. i can approve once emily is happy with canary plan. :thumbsup:

emily: reading the fallback snippet now. seems reasonable. one tiny ask: can you log when the fallback triggers with a sample_id and route_taken so we can correlate in observability?

olivia: added a structured log line in `fallbacks.go` (json keys: sample_id, route). pushed.

ci-bot: Canary scheduler — scheduled canary for PR #1234 in channel eng-canary at 2025-09-14T09:00:00Z (window 2h).

emily: thanks. approving now.

rahul: approved.

olivia: thanks all — quick question: should i squash the PR into one commit or keep the small fix commits? i'm fine either way.

rahul: squash plz, keeps history cleaner for that hotfix.

emily: +1 squash.

olivia: squashed and force-pushed. merging after canary completes. will post results. :rocket:
